summary: Skratch pulls on the final custom wishlist banner of Season 8 and advises players on whether it is worth their resources. He strongly recommends that free-to-play and low-spending players skip this banner entirely to save dice for Season 9 and the upcoming Anneliesis banner expected in December. He explains that this banner lacks the usual 30-dice rebate at 270 summons, making reaching the 300-summon milestone costly. As a high spender chasing Inspiration 5 for Serpentemis, he pulls to pity at 300 summons, acquiring copies of Vicana, Twitch, Durango, and multiple copies of Stegamoffyn along the way.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: A top-tier damage dealer whose extra inspirations are vital for high-end competitive play, but too expensive for F2P to chase.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Considered vastly more important than standard banner heroes, with an unconfirmed banner expected around December.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.verdict: Very good for Poison speed runs
heroes.note: A strong pickup for Poison team speed farming if a player does not already own him.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: A very capable Poison archetype unit worth having if missing from your roster.

heroes.name: Stegamoffyn
heroes.note: A legendary damage dealer who benefits heavily from full inspiration levels.

heroes.name: Vicana
heroes.note: Previously very strong against the Season 2 endgame boss, but generally lower priority now.

heroes.name: Szecedith
heroes.note: Mentioned as an option because she is slated to receive an exclusive artifact in the future.

tips: F2P and low spenders should skip end-of-season wishlist banners and hoard summons for Season 9 and Anneliesis.
This wishlist banner format does not grant the 30 bonus dice rebate at 270 pulls, requiring a full 300 summons to guarantee the first milestone.
Never pull on milestone banners unless you possess enough dice to reach the guaranteed 300-pull mark, as early legendary drops cannot be relied on.
title: I PULLED On The New Banner! Should You?? Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
